newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian crowd attacks Foreign Minister.
newsitem.headline: Albanian crowd attacks Foreign Minister.

text.p: Albanian Foreign Minister Tritan Shehu was attacked by an angry crowd of protesters in the southern town of Lushnje on Saturday, witnesses said.
"Shehu was attacked by the crowd when they recognised him. He must have been hit by a stone or hard object because his face is covered with blood," the witness said.
Shehu, who is also the chairman of the ruling Democratic Party, travelled to Lushnje, 85 km (55 miles) south of Tirana, to talk to the crowd to try to quell a two-day protest, the eyewitness said.

Shehu was surrounded by his bodyguards and plainclothes policemen who attempted to shield him from an angry crowd of Albanians, protesting over collapsing pyramid investment schemes. He later locked himself in locker rooms at the town football stadium to prevent the crowd from reaching him.
A government helicopter hovered over a nearby field but protesters prevented it from landing.
The demonstration began in Lushnje on Friday, when protesters set the town hall ablaze and stoned police officers who had arrived in trucks to try to end the disturbance.
